name: Categorical value specification
description: Represents how categorical rather than numeric values specify material characteristics, for instance a crystal structure of face-centered cubic, a grain structure of ferrite or an aggregate state of liquid. The categorical value specification is linked to the quality through specifies value of.
competency_questions: What non-numeric value does this material characteristic take? Which categorical value specification specifies the value of a given quality, and which entity is it about?
